import IO

let args = Proc.args ()

let fail code msg =
  IO.println_err msg
  Proc.exit code

let process dir old new rel =
  let p = Path.join dir rel
  let text = FS.read_file! p
  let parts = String.split old text
  let n = List.length parts - 1
  if n > 0 then
    FS.write_file! p (String.join new parts)
    [(Path.to_string rel, n)]
  else []

let main () =

  | [d, old, new] if old != "" ->
    let dir = Path.of_string d

      let total = List.fold_left (fn a r -> a + r.1) 0 res
      IO.println "changed %{List.length res} files, %{total} replacements"
  | _ -> fail 2 "usage: DIR OLD NEW (OLD non-empty)"

main ()
